items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was the Bob Crosby band with Bob Haggart at that time? [INTERVIEWEE] That’s right.

ctx.x: Yeah, listening, as you say, starting to listen to the radio and hear the bands that I like, and getting to the age where it was really, gee, I want to listen to that. Say ‘35, ‘6. I think the Bob Crosby band from the Black Hawk. I think — who did they — they followed Coon-Sanders I think was in there before, who didn’t impress me too much. But the Bob Crosby band, and then hearing Bob Zurke. I was very impressed with him. And of course on records Teddy Wilson I guess was the next.
Was the Bob Crosby band with Bob Haggart at that time?
